name: AppShell
purpose: Application chrome: NavigationBar is the stack (UINavigationBar); Navigation is the tab controller (UITabBarController) that morphs TabBar ↔ sidebar.
scenarios: Host a NavigationBar and one Navigation landmark so stack and tabs stay distinct
Morph that Navigation from a block-end tab bar to a side column as the shell widens
Keep specialized Sidebar or TabBar slots only when the chrome is intentionally single-form

header.description: Stack chrome. Pass NavigationBar (title, back, bar items). Not a site link row.

navigation.description: Tab controller. One node; compact is a UITabBar, 48rem/80rem move the same cell to the side column.

sidebar.description: Specialized side chrome that does not morph. Prefer navigation.

tabBar.description: Specialized compact chrome that does not morph. Prefer navigation. Hidden at desktop (80rem) when used as a legacy slot.

className.description: Additional CSS classes on the named app-shell container.

sidebarLabel.description: Accessible label for the sidebar region.

states.name: default
states.description: Shell is rendered with the current breakpoint layout.

antiPatterns: Do not compose Sidebar and TabBar for three-end chrome — pass Navigation once.
Do not put root destinations in the header; header is NavigationBar (stack), Navigation is the tab controller.
Do not make the side column overlap the main content without an explicit dismiss action.

keyboard: Tab moves through the header, sidebar, and main content in order
a11y.focus: Focus follows the document order; the sidebar is labelled.
a11y.labeling: Sidebar has an aria-label; main content is a main landmark.

responsive.strategy: Named container app-shell drives chrome. Compact pins Navigation at the block-end. From 48rem the same cell is a full-height start-edge sidebar; NavigationBar sits over main.

breakpoints.compact: Header + main scrollport + Navigation pinned to the block-end (or hidden legacy sidebar).
breakpoints.medium: 12rem start-edge sidebar spanning the shell height; NavigationBar + main in the content column.
breakpoints.large: 16rem start-edge sidebar, same pin; legacy TabBar slot is hidden.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. The sidebar border is on the inline-end; grid follows the document direction.

mechanics: AppShell is the named container app-shell. header is stack chrome (pass NavigationBar). navigation is the tab controller (pass Navigation once): CSS moves that cell from the block-end tab bar on compact to a start-edge column from 48rem (12rem) and 80rem (16rem). The shell fills its parent as a flex column with overflow hidden; it does not use min-block-size: 100dvh. sidebar and tabBar are single-form legacy slots. Layout morph is CSS; do not swap trees with matchMedia. Pair header NavigationBar with useTabStacks.
usage: Import AppShell, Navigation, NavigationBar, and useTabStacks from @chameleon-ui/components.
Pass NavigationBar as header and one Navigation as navigation. Children are the main landmark.
Drive Navigation with stacks.tab / stacks.selectTab. Drive NavigationBar with stacks.current, previous, canPop, and pop.
Do not compose Sidebar plus TabBar for three-end chrome. Do not put Navbar (site links) in header.

exports.name: AppShell
exports.description: Named container for stack chrome and the tab controller.

exports.name: AppShellProps
exports.description: header, children, navigation, plus legacy sidebar and tabBar slots.
